column2: But the one who protects me is neither ignorant nor powerless like you, but a being of great power...{wait}{clear}
One who dwells within me and grants me all of that power...{wait}{clear}
Heh heh heh, what a foolish angel you are... This is what you get for letting your guard down and showing yourself...{wait}{clear}
The one who lives within me has power beyond compare with yours.{wait}{clear}
Enough to strike down even you, who came down to the surface world as nothing but a soul.{wait}{clear}
Now, meddlesome angel, perish here and now.{wait}{clear}
?!{wait}{clear}
Are you all right, ＄＄＄＄＄＄?{wait}{clear}
Yes... I'm all right...{wait}{clear}
Let's get out of here, ＄＄＄＄＄＄.{wait}{clear}
Are you all right? The wound from back then...{wait}{clear}
Yes... What about you, Leyla? Aren't you tired?{wait}{clear}
I suppose... a little...{wait}{clear}
Please rest for now.{n}
That you're safe is...{n}
For now... please rest, Leyla. In time, I'm sure...{wait}{clear}
Yes... thank you...{wait}{clear}
＄＄＄＄＄＄, I'm sorry... It's my fault... you got hurt...{wait}{clear}
No, it's all right... What matters far more is that you're safe.{wait}{clear}
...I'm... powerless...{wait}{clear}
I can't... protect anything...{wait}{clear}
My father and mother were right in front of me, and I couldn't save them...{wait}{clear}
And on top of that... my recklessness got someone hurt...{wait}{clear}
You weren't wrong... Leyla... Rather than past deeds, let's think about what comes next.{wait}{clear}
...Yes.{wait}{clear}
Please rest, Leyla... It'll be... it'll be all right, I promise...{wait}{clear}
Why don't we rest a little?{wait}{clear}
Yes, let's...{wait}{clear}
What a beautiful sunset...{wait}{clear}
Such a peaceful sight... If I hadn't traveled, I'd surely never have known it...{wait}{clear}
And if... the person I used to be saw this same view...{wait}{clear}
I don't think I'd have understood how precious time flowing gently by can be...{wait}{clear}
I always believed... that being a knight was everything...{wait}{clear}
That winning battles and upholding the nation's prestige was worth more than anything...{wait}{clear}
That's what I thought...{wait}{clear}
But... now I know it's wrong to think that's all there is.{wait}{clear}
And you're the one who made me realize it...{wait}{clear}
Say, ＄＄＄＄＄＄, aren't you hungry?{wait}{clear}
Yes... I suppose I am, a little...{wait}{clear}
Why don't we eat together for once? But you can't go looking like that... Can't you take a human form?{wait}{clear}
